sloka: अमोघाः सूर्य संकाशा निशिता मे शरा इमे ।तस्मिन् वालिनि दुर्वृत्ते पतिष्यन्ति रुष अन्विताः ॥४-१०-३२॥
transliteration: amoghāḥ sūrya saṁkāśā niśitā me śarā ime ।tasmin vālini durvṛtte patiṣyanti ruṣa anvitāḥ ॥4-10-32॥

translations.english: 'These my sharp, unfailing arrows, bright as the Sun, released by me out of anger will descend on the evildoer, Vali.
